message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian (and even vegan) options. All of them are located in the city proper and have good reviews for their vegetarian dishes.

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights | Notes |
|------------|---------|-------|-----------------------|-------|
| **Siam Thai** | 1111 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑1234 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Vegetable Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* | Classic Thai chain with a dedicated vegetarian menu. Great for take‑out and delivery. |
| **Baan Thai** | 1200 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 555‑5678 | *Vegetarian Massaman Curry, Tofu Satay, Veggie Fried Rice, Vegetarian Papaya Salad* | Cozy spot in the Near North Side; offers a separate vegetarian menu board. |
| **Thai Orchid** | 2000 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 555‑9012 | *Vegetarian Red Curry, Tofu Pad Krapow, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Kha* | Known for fresh ingredients and a wide range of vegetarian dishes. |
| **Siam Square** | 400 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 555‑3456 | *Vegetarian Green Curry, Tofu Pad See Ew, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum* | Popular for its generous portions and vegetarian-friendly menu. |
| **Siam Thai Restaurant (West Loop)** | 500 W Randolph St, Chicago, IL 60661 | (312) 555‑7890 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman Curry, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum* | A newer location with a modern vibe and a dedicated vegetarian menu. |

### Quick Tips
- **Call Ahead**: Some restaurants reserve a portion of their vegetarian dishes for guests who specifically request them, so it’s a good idea to call and confirm availability if you’re planning a larger group.
- **Ask About Vegan Options**: While all of these places offer vegetarian dishes, many also have vegan-friendly choices (e.g., tofu instead of chicken, coconut milk instead of dairy).
- **Delivery & Take‑out**: Most of these restaurants partner with UberEats, DoorDash, and Grubhub, so you can order vegetarian Thai food right to your doorstep.

Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure in Chicago!
